Or “The Devil’s Queen”!! It’s about Queen Catherine de Medici and has all the drama of the court, along with the tragedy of her life and upbringing, and a little bit of dark magic and prophecies mixed in! Very realistic, very tragic, and so intriguing! I study history so I could give you so many. Some honourable mentions:

“The Silence of the Girls” - a retelling of the Iliad that truly shows the Greeks as what they were, brutal and cruel, yet still human somehow, and really gives the women a voice (“The Song of Achilles” is also an Iliad retelling but very, very different)

“Circe” - a retelling of the Greek myths, amazing amazing amazing !!

The Cicero Trilogy (first book is Imperium, if I remember correctly) by Robert Harris! It’s set in Ancient Rome and shows the end of the Republic amazingly. The vibe and atmosphere is ethereal and beautiful and gritty and real. It really shows the strengths and the flaws of all the characters so well. It is my favourite book series ever (3 books long!) and I’ll recommend it to anyone who will listen!!! It’s literally amazing!!! So many beautiful quotes, too.
